_about: Seed dataset for the message reader. tier 'regex' cases are asserted in CI by tests/evals.test.ts. tier 'llm' cases need the Gemini step: they are the start of the eval set you should grow to ~100 real (anonymised) messages and score against whichever model you use. Dates assume today = 2026-10-24.
